scenario: [LGRA.2.9.1]: in a triple-quoted literal a `\` takes the next character (`TRIPLE_CHAR ::= ... | '\\' ESCAPE_SEQ`), so in `"""trailing\"""` the `\"` is an escaped quote and cannot begin the closing `"""`. Only `""` and a newline follow it before the end of the source, so the literal never closes: [LLEX.15.2.1]'s "unterminated string literal: EOF before closing `"` or `"""`", a lexer error, DS_LEX_GENERIC. A compiler that closes the literal at `\"""` refuses the body's trailing `\` as DS_PARSE_BAD_ESCAPE. PATH PINNED: the backslash arm of `dsc.lex.llex_6_7_1_take_triple`.
